skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic issues of climate science and economic approaches to address climate change.
Analyze and evaluate economic and policy issues related to climate change at national, regional, and global levels.
Practice group work skills and develop independent research abilities.
Master economic tools and methods to analyze climate change issues.
Develop critical thinking skills to understand and evaluate climate change policies and economic impacts.
Improve presentation skills through group projects and class discussions.
Gain a global perspective on climate change and its economic implications.
Develop ethical awareness and social responsibility in the context of climate change.
